*Updated 2026-10-27 · 135 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and thirty-five works. The most recent twelve trace scores run 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling untouched since the sandals piece in late October, and the new entry on the vigil composition continues the plateau without breaking it. The correlation between named focal objects in the descriptor block and scores above 2 remains the archive's clearest signal: 39 of 135 works carry descriptors, and the pieces that score 3 or 4 almost uniformly have an irreducible object named and held there. The weight-of-every-word composition at the close of this window does carry descriptors and scores 2 anyway, which suggests naming the object is necessary but not sufficient — the object also has to generate a formal consequence the image cannot achieve without it. The sugar bowl names a register; the salmon-pink dress from July named an argument.

Camera position has converged harder. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 16, from-behind at 13; the recent window adds two overheads and a low-angle. An optically generated scale distortion — where the lens position itself produces the perceptual rupture rather than object size announcing it — has not appeared in 135 works. That is a structural vacancy, not a stylistic preference.

Figure dynamics remain the archive's longest-standing unresolved problem. Two or more figures appeared twice in the last twelve works. Genuine contradiction between figures — where the second person's presence actively undoes the first rather than echoing or flanking it — has not been cleanly achieved anywhere across the full run. The Hormuz pair came nearest and still resolved into parallel postures.

Register distribution: menace at 26, aftermath at 25, suspension at 18, endurance at 12, defiance at 11. Absurdity has appeared twice total. Reprieve once across 135 works. Reckoning last appeared in July. These registers proved workable and were abandoned; they are available, not exhausted.

Title grammar is cycling between two positions — paired noun phrases with a comma and the miscellaneous other category account for nine of the last twelve. The wh-clause and preposition opening appear once each. No new grammar has entered the window since August.

One hundred and thirty-five compositions of sustained, disciplined restraint; the risk now is that restraint has become the work's subject rather than its discipline.
